subject.title: [Bug]: A2A source reply repeats after successful message delivery

question: Should the embedded A2A delivery classifier treat a successful gateway-plugin `{ message: { id } }` result as visible delivery evidence for implicit `message_tool_only` replies?
rationale: The proposed distinction affects recovery semantics across messaging providers, so a maintainer should confirm the accepted result contract and negative cases before repair is dispatched.

options.title: Approve the narrow classifier contract
options.body: Recognize successful nested provider message IDs while preserving the existing non-delivery classifications for dry-run, suppression, no-op, and failures.

options.title: Define a broader provider receipt contract first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers specify whether other nested provider receipt shapes should be normalized through the same delivery-evidence path.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow classifier contract
recommendation.body: Recognize successful nested provider message IDs while preserving the existing non-delivery classifications for dry-run, suppression, no-op, and failures.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue contains the current reproduction and the most specific proposed behavioral contract, making this the best available routing candidate.
